name: Sonja Stump
office: City of Claremont, Member of the City Council, 3rd District

items.text: Sonja Stump is retired and owned Sonja Stump Photography until it closed in 2025. She chairs the city’s Traffic and Transportation Commission and serves on the boards of several local groups, including Claremont Meals on Wheels. The commission reviews the traffic impacts of major development proposals. Her campaign website lists six areas of focus: housing and affordability, environmental stewardship, local economic growth, education and youth, community connection, and public safety.
